socialPreview.imageAlt: Social preview for Joel Dombek’s resume
socialPreview.note: Shared preview reference for this POC. Individual pages should eventually provide page-specific Open Graph and X card metadata while retaining a consistent visual identity.

seoGuidance: Use accurate page-specific metadata, not repeated keyword stuffing.
Keep canonical URLs unique and consistent with the deployed root.
Use JSON-LD to describe real entities and relationships; do not create fake profiles or links.
Use XML sitemap and robots.txt at each canonical root when the site architecture is finalized.
Ensure every important page has a crawlable HTML anchor; JavaScript enhances rather than replaces navigation.
